summary: Iteration 4 (multi-channel + MMDVM bindings + Dispatcher ACL) tested end-to-end. Backend: 52 passed / 1 skipped across backend_test.py, test_v12_features.py, test_channels.py (updated to id-based), and new test_iteration4.py (17 tests). Frontend: verified RepeaterConfigPanel visible for admin, modal opens, save creates rc-row-{id}, delete removes it; channel chips now keyed by id (all/slot-1/slot-2); AdminUsers Groups button (data-testid=groups-{id}) opens UserGroupsModal, toggle+save persists allowed_group_ids and closes modal.

minor.issue: The ternary in server.py:530 is hard to read: q['group_id'] = {'$in': allowed if not group_id else [group_id]} if not group_id or group_id in allowed else {'$in': []}. Works correctly but consider splitting into an if/elif for maintainability.

issues: Right-side form is not pre-filled when clicking a row on the left; add/edit only supports 'add' + overwrite-by-ID. Nice-to-have: click a row to load it into the edit form.

action_items: (Optional) Refactor the /api/radios ACL ternary for readability.
(Optional/UX) Allow clicking a configured MMDVM row to pre-fill the edit form in RepeaterConfigModal.
critical_code_review_comments: dmr_ingest.py::_handle_dmrd correctly resolves src_channel_id via channel_router.channel_for_slot, iterates all authenticated peers, calls slot_for_channel to skip non-carrying MMDVMs, and rewrites bit 7 of byte 15 for slot swap. Verified by code inspection - cannot exercise live in preview (no real MMDVMs).

channels.py::ChannelStore.delete correctly unbinds by rewriting repeater_configs.slot{1,2}_channel_id back to slot-{1,2}; also rejects deletion of built-in slot-1/slot-2 with ValueError -> 400 in server.

channels.py::RepeaterConfigStore.slot_for_channel returns None for unknown channel on non-configured repeater which correctly causes the relay path to SKIP that MMDVM. Legacy repeaters (no config) still receive slot-1/slot-2 frames since their channel_id maps 1:1.
server.py PATCH /api/channels still accepts legacy '1' and '2' path segments and maps to slot-1/slot-2 - back-compat preserved.
auth.py::to_public exposes allowed_group_ids: [] by default; UserPublic model has the field with default. Correct.
RepeaterConfigPanel gated by user?.role === 'admin'; returns null for non-admin so panel not rendered.
seed_data_creation: test_iteration4.py creates ephemeral TEST_ users (registered + approved, some deleted post-test), transient channels (uuid), transient repeater_configs (rid ~988xxxx/999xxxx), and ephemeral radios (6.5M range) - all cleaned up in-test. Frontend script created a MMDVM binding 3123456 + a TEST_ui user and cleaned up both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 backend + frontend all green. test_channels.py assertions were migrated from `slot` to `id`-based model. Voice relay live-path could not be tested (no real MMDVMs) - covered only by code inspection assertion. Prior 35 tests in backend_test.py+test_v12_features.py still pass (plus 1 legacy skip in test_auto_assign).
rca of the issue: N/A - all requested iteration-4 features (multi-channel model, MMDVM channel bindings API + UI, Dispatcher ACL enforcement on /api/radios and /api/messages, admin groups endpoint, voice relay channel-aware routing) verified.
